2026.03.09

Joomla system plugin AstroidGhsvs 2026.03.09

Joomla system plugin to support templates based on the Astroid/Templaza framework AND/OR also other templates. E.g. for more controllable SCSS compilation.

### Download
[plg_system_astroidghsvs-2026.03.09_2.1.0.0.zip](https://github.com/GHSVS-de/plg_system_astroidghsvs/raw/2026.03.09/dist/plg_system_astroidghsvs-2026.03.09_2.1.0.0.zip)
